title: torilis melanantha
intro: Torilis melanantha, commonly known as Black Lovage or Black Hognut, is a flowering plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Torilis melanantha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects. The therapeutic actions of Torilis melanantha also include its ability to relax muscles, improve sleep quality, and reduce anxiety due to its sedative properties.
